role: Assistant Secretary, Department of Housing and Urban Development
stance_basis: responded directly to Federal Power Commission letter in detail, addressing their concerns about total energy systems
summary: Assistant Secretary Finger responded directly to the Federal Power Commission's letter regarding total energy systems and related design concerns. The response was detailed enough to warrant a separate letter, a copy of which was attached to the incoming FPC letter in the Appendix. No explicit position for or against the project is attributed to Finger; the response appears to be an administrative/technical reply on behalf of HUD.
